what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Sierra Leone in the United States: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 632 Sierra Leonean asylum seekers in the United States, 7.6% of all asylum seekers from Sierra Leone.
Refugees from Sierra Leone, a separate group, live mostly in France, Guinea, Germany and Greece.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Sierra Leone in every year from 1995 to 2001, with the RUF and AFRC among the opponents.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2001 to 2004 and 2023 to 2024.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 544 asylum seekers and fell to a low in 2010.
The figure was at its highest, 1588, at the end of 2024, and was lower at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United States.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for the United States only.
